title: Whizzify
tagline: Whizzify AI Agent automates quiz generation and instant rewards using AI and Ethereum. It creates quizzes from session content, evaluates responses, and distributes rewards via MetaMask, ensuring seamless engagement and transparency for organizations and participants.
description:
Whizzify AI Agent: Revolutionizing Engagement with AI & Ethereum
Overview
Whizzify AI Agent is an autonomous Web3-powered engagement platform that enables organizations to assess participant interaction effortlessly. By leveraging AI for quiz generation and Ethereum smart contracts for instant rewards, Whizzify ensures a transparent, interactive, and rewarding experience.

Problem Statement
Organizations conducting sessions, webinars, and workshops struggle with:

Manual Quiz Creation: Crafting relevant quizzes is time-consuming and often lacks contextual accuracy.
Reward Management Complexity: Manually tracking, verifying, and distributing rewards is prone to errors and inefficiencies.
Participant Engagement Issues: Keeping attendees actively involved without incentives is challenging.
The Whizzify Solution
Whizzify eliminates these challenges through AI-driven automation and blockchain transparency:

AI-powered Quiz Generation:

Automatically creates quizzes from live sessions or uploaded content.
Generates dynamic, adaptive questions tailored to participant engagement.
Instant Ethereum-based Rewards:

Uses Ethereum smart contracts for secure, automatic reward distribution.
Participants receive rewards directly in their MetaMask wallets upon correct answers.
Seamless Engagement & Analytics:

Tracks engagement metrics (response speed, accuracy, participation rate).
Provides AI-driven insights to optimize future sessions.
How It Works
Session Processing: Organizations upload session content or allow AI to transcribe live discussions.
Quiz Generation: AI extracts key concepts and generates tailored quiz questions.
Participant Interaction: Users take quizzes via the chatbot or web platform.
Answer Evaluation: AI evaluates responses and determines correctness.
Reward Distribution: Ethereum smart contracts handle instant, tamper-proof payouts via MetaMask.
Analytics & Reporting: Organizations receive detailed reports on engagement and learning outcomes.
Tech Stack
AI & NLP: ChatGPT API for question generation and answer evaluation.
Blockchain: Ethereum smart contracts for secure and automated transactions.
Wallet Integration: MetaMask for instant user authentication and payouts.
Speech-to-Text: Whisper API for real-time session transcription.
Frontend: React.js-based chatbot and web interface for seamless interaction.
Key Benefits
✅ No Manual Effort: AI handles quiz creation, evaluation, and rewards autonomously.
✅ Ethereum Smart Contracts: Ensures instant, fair, and transparent reward distribution.
✅ Enhanced Engagement: Real-time interaction with AI-powered quizzes.
✅ Seamless Wallet Integration: Participants easily connect MetaMask to receive rewards.
✅ Data-driven Insights: Organizations optimize learning experiences with AI analytics.

Conclusion
Whizzify AI Agent transforms the way organizations engage participants by making quiz creation, evaluation, and reward distribution fully autonomous. With AI and Ethereum, Whizzify ensures seamless, transparent, and rewarding interactions, setting a new standard for Web3-powered engagement platforms. 🚀
how_its_made: Whizzify AI Agent is built using a combination of AI, Ethereum smart contracts, and Web3 wallet integration, ensuring seamless automation of quiz generation, participant evaluation, and reward distribution. The core of the system leverages OpenAI’s ChatGPT API to process session content—whether uploaded documents, slides, or real-time transcriptions using Whisper API—and dynamically generate context-aware quiz questions. The frontend, developed with React.js and Next.js, provides an intuitive interface for organizations and participants, while Node.js and Express handle backend logic, managing API requests and quiz interactions. The AI evaluates responses, determining correctness and awarding partial points for close answers. To ensure instant, fair, and verifiable reward distribution, Whizzify integrates Ethereum smart contracts, triggered via Ethers.js, with payouts directly executed through MetaMask wallets. The Solidity-based smart contract follows a gas-optimized model using ERC-2771 meta-transactions, making transactions cost-efficient. Additionally, Whizzify tracks engagement metrics, such as response accuracy and participation frequency, storing quiz results and session insights in PostgreSQL, with Redis used for caching active interactions. The platform also includes a multi-signature fallback mechanism to prevent reward losses due to transaction failures. By integrating AI-driven automation, real-time engagement analytics, and Web3-native financial incentives, Whizzify eliminates manual work, making engagement assessment transparent, efficient, and rewarding. 🚀
